Package mediator

Class ClientHandler

java.lang.Object
mediator.ClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ClientHandler extends Object implements Runnable
Handles communication between server and a single client socket. Processes incoming JSON packages and responds accordingly. Supports handling of Order and Menu packages.
